secondaries.text: It was 2024 when Young Bucks & Okada vs. FTR & Danielson vs. The Young Bucks vs. FTR vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Jack Perry vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Darby Allin fought it out in an Anarchy in the Arena match, in the night's main event on Double or Nothing, rated 8.31 ? an excellent showing, part of the special Double or Nothing '24 card. Jack Perry's interference helped The Elite overcome Team AEW in the chaotic Anarchy in the Arena brawl, the fight spilling out of the ring and through the crowd before Perry's low blow turned the tide for good.

That Sunday in 2024, Adam Copeland vs. Malakai Black put the AEW TNT Title on the line in a Barbed Wire Steel Cage match, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.40 ? a well-worked match. This stood as the 90th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a real piece of championship history. In a bloody Barbed Wire Steel Cage match, a returning Gangrel helped fight off House of Black's interference, letting Copeland choke out Malakai Black with barbed wire to retain the TNT Title.
